facts.value: If you are an international student in Frankfurt or are coming soon, you can find detailed information about studying and living in Frankfurt on the Global Office pages of Goethe University.

value: Working while studying and questions about work permits
Electronic management of study and examination data (study certificates, fee account, generating new iTAN list, and certificates of examinations taken and registered)

facts.value: For students with disabilities or chronic illnesses, comprehensive support services are available to ensure barrier-free studies.
If you are experiencing doubts about your studies, have severe exam anxiety, or feel overwhelmed and helpless, you are encouraged to seek help from competent support services.
Goethe University and the Student Union offer numerous counseling and support services on the topic of 'Studying with Child.'
As an expectant mother, consult the examination office of the Faculty of Business Administration at the beginning of your pregnancy regarding new legal regulations for maternity protection.

The Antidiscrimination Office is part of the Equal Opportunity Office and works as a counseling, mediation, and specialist office to support affected individuals in managing discrimination experiences.
The Goethe-Uni Law Clinic offers free legal advice on various topics including residence, migration and social law, and applying for social benefits.
